name: Guide new signups to activation with Claude using Segment and HubSpot

parameters.content:
## Guide new signups to activation with Claude using Segment and HubSpot

Product and success teams whose new customers stall between signup and first value.

### How it works
Trigger: The product or billing system posts new signups; a daily Schedule Trigger evaluates every account still in onboarding against milestone deadlines.
1. Register the new account
2. Track milestones from product events
3. Detect stalls
4. Send the right nudge
5. Answer setup questions
6. Escalate to a person
7. Celebrate activation and hand over
8. Report the funnel
Every AI step is followed by a "Needs a person?" gate that parks low-confidence items.

### Setup
1. Open "Config (edit me)" and fill in the fields (names, approver, quiet hours, thresholds).
2. Add credentials: Anthropic, plus Segment / Mixpanel / PostHog, HubSpot / Intercom.
3. Run once with test_mode on, read the output, then switch the trigger on.

### Customization tips
Set the milestones and the nudge timing in the Config node; replace Segment with Mixpanel or PostHog.
Guardrail to keep: Nudges are sent only on stalls, with a cap of one per milestone; no message for customers making progress.

Full blueprint: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/customer-onboarding-automation/

## 1. Register the new account
Account, plan, segment, signup source and the milestone set that applies (self-serve vs sales-assisted have different milestones and deadlines)

## 2. Track milestones from product events
Reads the activation events from product analytics or the app's own API and marks milestones complete with timestamps

nodes.name: Section: 2. Track milestones from product events

parameters.content:
## 3. Detect stalls
A milestone past its expected day with no progress is a stall

## 4. Send the right nudge
The agent writes a short message for this stall — the specific next step, one link, an offer to help — using the customer's plan and what they have already done

## 5. Answer setup questions
Replies to onboarding emails and in-app chat from the documentation with citations; questions it cannot answer become a ticket with the account's milestone context attached

## 6. Escalate to a person
Two consecutive stalls, a negative reply, or a high-value account stalling on the first milestone alerts the CSM with the history and a suggested call agenda

## 7. Celebrate activation and hand over
On the final milestone the account moves to 'activated', the CSM or the retention workflows take over, and the onboarding record is closed with its timeline

nodes.name: Section: 7. Celebrate activation and hand over

Weekly milestone funnel by segment and signup source: where customers stall and how long each step takes, which is the product team's onboarding backlog

Detect stalls

A milestone past its expected day with no progress is a stall. Stalls are classified by which milestone, because the fix differs.

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Send the right nudge" step of the Customer Onboarding Automation workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: The agent writes a short message for this stall — the specific next step, one link, an offer to help — using the customer's plan and what they have already done. No generic drips.

Rules:
- Nudges are sent only on stalls, with a cap of one per milestone; no message for customers making progress.
- The setup-question agent answers from documentation with citations and escalates unknowns.
- High-value accounts get a person on the first stall, not the third.
- Every automated message is logged on the account so the CSM sees the full history.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.
